output.reason: Localized itchy blistery rash confined to both forearms after reported poison ivy exposure, with fever and breathing trouble denied; a clinician task remains (assessment of severity and whether prescription treatment is warranted) but nothing reported establishes time-critical or in-person need.
output.patientMessage: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your rash in this message thread, with a same-day target during service hours. Your description fits a contact rash limited to both forearms. Regardless of messaging: seek same-day in-person care if you develop fever, spreading warmth, pus or increasing pain, or eye, face or genital involvement; call 911 for throat tightness or breathing difficulty. If clinician review isn't available, contact an urgent care or your usual clinic directly.

output.vitalSigns: No vital-sign values reported — temperature, heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate and oxygen saturation are all unreported; whether any were measured is unknown. Fever and breathing trouble were denied by symptom report only, which does not establish a measured temperature.
output.evidenceLimitations: The contact dermatitis and allergic reaction sources are agent-compiled emergency-department reference syntheses, not telehealth protocols or primary guidelines, and their currency is not assessed; the consumer summaries support general symptom and self-care scope only. Rash extent, distribution details and any facial/ocular/genital involvement were not described, so severity grading is uncertain.

citations.claim: Localized contact dermatitis without mucosal involvement, limited body surface area and no systemic symptoms is generally managed with outpatient discharge, allergen counseling and return precautions rather than emergency care.
citations.limitation: ED-reference synthesis; exact body-surface-area percentage for this patient was not reported.

citations.claim: Apparent spread of a poison ivy rash reflects delayed sensitization in lower-exposure areas rather than blister fluid spreading the rash.
citations.limitation: Agent-compiled synthesis, not a primary guideline.

citations.claim: Severe poison ivy rashes warrant clinician evaluation.
citations.limitation: Consumer summary; no severity threshold defined.
